name: sAlex
brief: A deduplicated subsample of the Alexandria database, released with OMat24 as fine-tuning data. OMat24's own DFT settings differ from the Materials Project's, so models pretrained on it are fine-tuned on MPtrj and sAlex together to align with the Materials Project reference that Matbench-Discovery assumes.
paperTitle: Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) Inorganic Materials Dataset and Models
primaryPaper: Schmidt et al., Machine-Learning-Assisted Determination of the Global Zero-Temperature Phase Diagram of Materials, Adv. Mater. (2023).
